subs.name: The weekly narrative
subs.title: The weekly narrative
subs.body: Once a week Vidlun writes what it read in your entries: how the tone moved and what repeats. It is the only paid thing here.
subs.item1: The full week, not the first paragraph
subs.item2: Patterns noticed — when they are really there
subs.free: The mood chart, journal, search, vocabulary and backup stay free forever.
subs.trialBody: The narrative is open. When the week ends we will say so plainly — what you already read stays yours.
subs.manageBody: Manage and cancel in the App Store. Everything you already read stays yours.
buy.errBody: The payment was declined or the connection dropped. Nothing was charged.
buy.noneBody: No Vidlun subscription was found on this Apple ID.
stats.patternNoneBody: Nothing repeating showed up this week. Patterns do not turn up every week — that is fine.

settings.keepRecordingsHint: Recordings stay on this phone for a year, then go. The written entry stays for good.
settings.forgetBody: Every kept recording goes. The entries themselves stay.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Tell it how the day went. Vidlun does the rest.
onboarding.privacyOnDevice: Speech is recognised on this phone. Your voice is never sent anywhere.
onboarding.privacyKeep: Recordings stay on this phone for a year, then go on their own. The written entry stays for good.
onboarding.privacyDelete: Any entry can be deleted, and its recording goes with it.
onboarding.micBody: So you can just say it instead of typing.
onboarding.downloading: Vidlun is downloading what it listens with — {{done}} of {{total}} MB
onboarding.downloadLater: The download carries on in the background. You can write an entry now.
settings.themeHint: Matching the phone darkens with it in the evening. A chosen theme always stays.
processing.hint: Reading the words and finding ones for the mood. A few seconds.
turn.question: What word would you give it?
turn.hint: One or two feelings. There is no right answer.
turn.hidden: what Vidlun heard — after your answer
turn.skip: I don't know — just show me
diff.same: The same word. Vidlun has nothing to add.
diff.more: Vidlun also hears "{{word}}" — in your own words.
diff.missing: Vidlun did not hear "{{word}}". It is not in the words — but it was in you.
diff.other: Different words: "{{mine}}" and "{{theirs}}". Vidlun is not arguing.
diff.silent: No word came — that is an answer too. Vidlun leaves its own beside yours, not instead.
detail.disclaimer: Vidlun describes what was said. It gives no advice, verdicts or medical conclusions.
detail.audioGone: No audio kept — recordings are switched off in settings.
record.limitFree: A free recording runs up to a minute

subs.noteLifetime: One payment of {{price}}. Nothing renews, nothing to cancel.
